info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Equipment Management API
info.description: The Equipment Management API enables organizations to update details related to their equipment administered within banking facilities. This API is designed for facility managers and operational staff to efficiently modify equipment parameters, ensuring accurate records and streamlined operations. By leveraging this API, users can maintain compliance and enhance inventory control. It supports various operational workflows where timely equipment updates are crucial to business processes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows for the modification of the equipment administration details for the specified resource identifier (RES-100045). Users can send a patch request with the relevant fields that need to be updated. Ensure to provide valid data in the request body to successfully update the equipment details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the specific operational details of equipment administration for the facility identified by RES-100045. Ensure that all necessary fields are included to correctly process the update.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the resource has been updated.
